Thanks again for the time today — great to meet you all. Quick recap and next steps from my side so we have alignment on procurement/commercial path:\u2028

- Current status: POC completed with Emma (engineering) and team; positive signals on perf and infra footprint.
- Procurement preference: Sonia mentioned the org prefers PO + vendor setup for anything > $50k, otherwise card is acceptable for smaller transactions.
- Key asks from procurement for vendor onboarding: W-9, master SOW, standard vendor form, and the Acme PO template.
- Approvals: Sonia to drive procurement review; Jason Hart is the finance sponsor (permissioned for budget sign-off). Sonia indicated the final signatory is likely Peter Collins (VP Ops), but she will confirm.

Proposed next steps:\u2028
1) I attached a first-pass SOW and our standard W-9 for your procurement team to review. (see attachments: Redwood_SOW_draft_v1.pdf)
2) Sonia — can you confirm whether Acme requires Net 30 vs Net 45 for new vendors and whether you need an initial vendor questionnaire completed?
3) Emma — can you confirm expected production start date if procurement completes within 2-3 weeks? That helps us scope licensing and infra provisioning.

If you prefer, we can also go via AWS Marketplace (we're listed) but Sonia mentioned marketplace onboarding might take longer — worth discussing if you want single-supplier procurement.

Thanks — I'll loop in our finance/ops lead if there are any unusual T&Cs to review.

Best,

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and for sending the SOW. A few answers from procurement:\u2028

- Purchase method: For this engagement we will prefer a PO (internal vendor onboarding) — card payments are usually limited to one-off purchases and low-dollar items.
- Payment terms: We typically operate Net 45 for new vendors; procurement may agree to Net 30 after the second renewal depending on spend.
- Required docs: Please provide W-9, vendor contact, insurance cert (if applicable), and a completed vendor questionnaire (I've attached our template).
- Approver chain: Jason Hart (Finance) is the budget owner and will review spend; final signatory is Peter Collins (VP Ops). I'll confirm the signatory in writing once I have the vendor packet.

We can start vendor setup in parallel with legal review of the SOW. If you can complete the vendor questionnaire and send the W-9, that will speed things up. I've attached Acme_PO_Template.xlsx for your reference.

Regarding Marketplace: we have internal interest in marketplace procurement for recurring SaaS, but Marketplace onboarding requires security attestation which may add 3-4 weeks. For a faster path, PO + vendor setup looks best.

Thanks,
Sonia Patel
Sr. Procurement Manager
Acme Corp.
sonia.patel@acmecorp.com

Marissa — thanks for the recap and for looping us in. A few internal notes:

- Pricing/terms: OK to proceed with standard list pricing and a 10% first-year commercial discount for a committed PO (subject to legal review). If Acme requests Net 45, we can accept but prefer monthly billing in arrears; finance can handle Net 45 for PO customers if needed.
- Paperwork: Aditya, please prep a vendor packet checklist (W-9, COI, SOW, PO routing instructions) Marissa can send to Sonia.
- Marketplace: If Acme decides to go marketplace later, we should keep that as a secondary path — not required upfront.

Proceed to get the vendor questionnaire completed and let me know if they push unusual terms. I'll standby to expedite any pricing approvals.
